# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.

# graph_headroom — evolution seed for the dev-continuum-* family.  Identity stays
# outside EVOLVE-BLOCKs; Shinka operators may change only the implementation below.
#
# Why this seed and not `least_allocated` (the dev-medium-hot seed): on this family the
# dependency-blind policies are *infeasible* (worst SLO 0.88 against a 0.90 target), so
# seeding from one would start every arm outside the feasible region and turn the first
# half of every campaign into a feasibility hunt rather than a search.  This seed is the
# most SLO-margined feasible hand-written policy (0.95); it is also the *expensive* one
# (1.27 normalized energy against `latency_greedy`'s 0.83), which is deliberate — the
# search starts feasible and has an explicit, large energy gap to close rather than
# starting at the best baseline with nowhere to go.
POLICY_NAME: str = "graph_headroom"
POLICY_VERSION: str = "1.0.0"

# EVOLVE-BLOCK-START
def avg_latency(pod_id: int, node_idx: int, state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx) -> float:
    weighted = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    edges = len(graph.src)
    for e in range(edges):
        source = graph.src[e]
        destination = graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if source == pod_id:
            other = destination
        if destination == pod_id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod_id:
            neighbor = state.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                rate = graph.rate[e]
                weighted = weighted + rate * state.nodes[node_idx].latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                weight = weight + rate
    if weight > 0.0:
        return weighted / weight
    return 0.0

def score(pod: Pod, node: NodeState, ctx: ClusterCtx) -> float:
    if node.suspended:
        return -1000000.0
    cpu_cap = float(max(node.cpu_capacity, 1))
    mem_cap = float(max(node.mem_capacity, 1))
    cpu_after = float(node.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
    mem_after = float(node.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap
    peak = max(cpu_after, mem_after)
    if peak > 0.85:
        return -1000000.0

    idle_cost = 0.0
    if node.cpu_allocated == 0:
        idle_cost = node.power_idle_w
    dynamic = (node.power_max_w - node.power_idle_w) * cpu_after
    energy_cost = idle_cost + dynamic

    weighted = 0.0
    weight = 0.0
    edges = len(ctx.graph.src)
    for e in range(edges):
        source = ctx.graph.src[e]
        destination = ctx.graph.dst[e]
        other = -1
        if source == pod.id:
            other = destination
        if destination == pod.id:
            other = source
        if other >= 0 and other != pod.id:
            neighbor = ctx.pods[other]
            if neighbor.current_node >= 0:
                rate = ctx.graph.rate[e]
                weighted = weighted + rate * node.latency_to_ms[neighbor.current_node]
                weight = weight + rate

    avg_lat = 0.0
    if weight > 0.0:
        avg_lat = weighted / weight

    cost = energy_cost + avg_lat * 0.6
    return -cost

def contains(lst: list[int], x: int) -> bool:
    for item in lst:
        if item == x:
            return True
    return False

def propose_moves(state: ClusterState, graph: CallGraphCtx, budget: int) -> list[Move]:
    out: list[Move] = []
    if budget <= 0:
        return out
    moved = 0
    moved_pods: list[int] = []
    num_pods = len(state.pods)
    num_nodes = len(state.nodes)
    for i in range(num_pods):
        if moved >= budget:
            return out
        pod = state.pods[i]
        movable = pod.current_node >= 0 and not pod.stateful and not pod.has_pdb and not contains(moved_pods, pod.id)
        if movable:
            src_node = state.nodes[pod.current_node]
            src_cpu_cap = float(max(src_node.cpu_capacity, 1))
            src_dyn = (src_node.power_max_w - src_node.power_idle_w) * (float(pod.cpu_request) / src_cpu_cap)
            src_idle_saved = 0.0
            if src_node.cpu_allocated == pod.cpu_request:
                src_idle_saved = src_node.power_idle_w
            current_lat = avg_latency(pod.id, pod.current_node, state, graph)
            best_node = -1
            best_savings = 0.0
            for j in range(num_nodes):
                if j != pod.current_node:
                    dest = state.nodes[j]
                    cpu_cap = float(max(dest.cpu_capacity, 1))
                    mem_cap = float(max(dest.mem_capacity, 1))
                    cpu_after = float(dest.cpu_allocated + pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap
                    mem_after = float(dest.mem_allocated + pod.mem_request) / mem_cap
                    peak = max(cpu_after, mem_after)
                    dest_dyn = (dest.power_max_w - dest.power_idle_w) * (float(pod.cpu_request) / cpu_cap)
                    dest_idle = 0.0
                    if dest.cpu_allocated == 0:
                        dest_idle = dest.power_idle_w
                    savings = src_idle_saved + src_dyn - dest_dyn - dest_idle
                    acceptable = not dest.suspended and peak < 0.85 and savings > best_savings
                    if acceptable:
                        cand_lat = avg_latency(pod.id, j, state, graph)
                        if cand_lat <= current_lat + 15.0:
                            best_savings = savings
                            best_node = j
            if best_node >= 0:
                out.append(move_pod(pod.id, best_node))
                moved_pods.append(pod.id)
                moved = moved + 1
    return out
# EVOLVE-BLOCK-END
